item.title: Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on 32nd Anniversary of Kim Il Sung's Death, "Wishing Eternal Life to the Great Leader" (김정은, 김일성 32주기 금수산태양궁전 참배… “위대한 수령님 영생 축원”)
item.description:
North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong Un visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, where the bodies of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il are preserved, on the 32nd anniversary of Chairman Kim Il Sung's death on the 8th. (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 김일성 주석 사망 32주기인 8일 김일성·김정일 시신이 보존돼 있는 금수산태양궁전을 참배했다.)

North Korea's Korean Central News Agency reported that Kim Jong Un visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun in Pyongyang at midnight on that day. (북한 조선중앙통신은 김정은이 이날 0시 평양의 금수산태양궁전을 찾았다고 보도했다.)

The agency stated, "Participants included members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, leading party and government officials, workers of the Party Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Cabinet, committees, ministry officials, and command members of military organs." (통신은 “조선노동당 중앙위원회 정치국 상무위원회 위원들을 비롯한 당과 정부의 지도 간부들과 당 중앙위원회 일꾼들, 최고인민회의 상임위원회, 내각, 위원회, 성 책임 일꾼들, 무력 기관의 지휘 성원들이 참가했다”고 전했다.)

The agency reported, "Comrade Kim Jong Un, along with the participants, paid noble respects to the statues of the great leader and the great general. Comrade Kim Jong Un then visited the halls of eternal life and paid solemn respects, wishing eternal life to the great leader and the great general." (통신은 “김정은 동지께서는 참가자들과 함께 위대한 수령님과 위대한 장군님의 입상을 우러러 숭고한 경의를 표시하셨다”고 했다. 이어 “김정은 동지께서는 영생홀들을 찾으시어 위대한 수령님과 위대한 장군님께 영생 축원의 인사를 삼가 드리셨다”고 했다.)

The agency described the anniversary of Kim Il Sung's death as "the greatest day of remembrance for our party, state, and people" and claimed, "All people of the country and People's Army soldiers are filled with boundless longing and reverence for the rare great sage who made 'changing the world, enriching the country and strengthening the military' his lifelong motto, elevated our party and state into a true people's party and a genuine people's country, and laid the eternal foundation of our style of socialism, advancing triumphantly through independence, self-reliance, and self-defense." (통신은 김일성 사망일에 대해 “우리 당과 국가, 인민의 최대의 추모의 날”이라며 “온 나라 전체 인민과 인민군 장병은 이민위천, 부국강병을 필생의 좌우명으로 삼으시고 우리 당과 국가를 참다운 인민의 당, 진정한 인민의 나라로 일떠세우셨으며 자주, 자립, 자위로 승승장구하는 우리식 사회주의의 만년 기틀을 다져주신 희세의 대성인에 대한 다함없는 그리움과 경모심에 넘쳐 있다”고 주장했다.)

North Korean media often report Kim Jong Un's activities the day after an event, but news of this visit was reported on the same day. (북한 매체들은 김정은의 동정을 행사 다음 날 전하는 경우가 많지만, 이날 참배 소식은 당일에 보도했다.)

This year's anniversary of Kim Il Sung's death does not fall on a significant 5- or 10-year cycle that North Korea emphasizes, so large-scale commemorative events with Kim Jong Un's attendance are not expected to occur. (올해 김일성 사망일은 북한이 중시하는 5년, 10년 단위 주기가 아니어서, 김정은이 참석하는 대규모 기념 행사는 열리지 않을 것으로 보인다.)

Kim Jong Un attended a central memorial meeting held at Pyongyang's Kim Il Sung Square in 2024, the 30th anniversary of Kim Il Sung's death, following his visit to the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun. (김정은은 김일성 30주기인 2024년에는 금수산태양궁전 참배에 이어 평양 김일성광장에서 열린 중앙 추모 대회에도 참석했다.)

item.title: Will 2.47 Million Ballots from Jamsil Be Opened? Rival Parties Moving Toward Recount Agreement (잠실 247만장 투표함 여나… 여야, 재검표 합의 수순)
item.description:
Will 2.47 Million Ballots from Jamsil Be Opened? Rival Parties Moving Toward Recount Agreement (잠실 247만장 투표함 여나… 여야, 재검표 합의 수순)

A recount is expected for 2.47 million ballots from the local elections stored at the Olympic Handball Stadium in Songpa-gu, Seoul. Citizens protesting the ballot shortage have been holding rallies in front of the stadium, which served as a counting site, for over a month. (서울 송파구 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장에 보관 중인 지방선거 투표용지 247만장에 대해 재검표가 이뤄질 전망이다. 투표용지 부족 사태에 항의하는 시민들은 개표소로 쓰였던 경기장 앞에서 한 달 넘게 집회를 하고 있다.)

Han Byeong-do, the acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated at a party strategy meeting held at the National Assembly on the 7th, "We will actively review the recount plan proposed by the special parliamentary committee for investigation." Kim Seong-hoe, the party's floor spokesperson, told reporters, "We are open to a recount if necessary." (한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 7일 국회에서 열린 원내대책회의에서 “국조특위에서 추진하는 (재검표) 방안을 적극 검토할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 민주당 김성회 원내대변인은 기자들과 만나 “재검표가 필요하면 하자는 입장”이라고 했다.)

Yoon Sang-hyun, a lawmaker from the People Power Party and chair of the special committee for the parliamentary investigation into the ballot shortage, has requested both parties to recount the ballots stored at the handball stadium. The National Election Commission (NEC) previously reported to the committee a plan to publicly recount the ballots at the stadium and then move them to the NEC headquarters in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi. The NEC stated that with a budget of 50 million won and 440 personnel, the recount would take nine hours. Kang Dong-wan, acting secretary-general of the NEC, said at the committee meeting, "If the National Assembly passes a resolution, we will proceed with the public recount immediately." <<> Around 380 ballot boxes, totaling 2.47 million ballots, and 104 voting records are currently stored at the handball stadium, which was used as a counting site for the June 3 local elections in Songpa-gu, Seoul. Following the ballot shortage, protests outside the stadium have prevented their removal for over a month. <<> Committee chair Yoon Sang-hyun said at the special committee meeting, "The recount is a way to resolve distrust in the NEC, especially as a minimal measure to embrace citizens outside the stadium calling for protection of their voting rights." A political source noted, "If we first confirm whether there were errors in the Songpa-gu election and counting process, it could offer a clue to resolving the prolonged protests." <<> However, some in the opposition are cautious about the recount. Lee Jun-seok, a lawmaker from the Reform Party and a member of the special committee, said, "Integrity can be verified to some extent by checking the sealed condition of the ballots. If we proceed with a political recount, those alleging fraud might question why it was done." <<> The special committee conducted on-site inspections at the NEC headquarters in Gwacheon and the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission in Jongno-gu, Seoul, on the same day. It was confirmed that the Seoul Songpa-gu Election Commission first recognized the ballot shortage at 11:34 a.m. on the 3rd of last month, but the report reached Wi Cheol-hwan, then a standing NEC commissioner (now acting NEC chair), only at 6:10 p.m. Joo Jin-woo, a People Power Party lawmaker, said, "There was chaos due to a lack of ballots, and Acting Chair Wi was only briefed after the voting had already concluded." <<> Lee Ki-heon, a Democratic Party lawmaker, said, "The NEC situation room first noticed the ballot shortage at 4:25 p.m., but it wasn't until 50 minutes later at 5:08 p.m. that they realized the severity after confirming with the Seoul Election Commission. The lax work of the election situation room escalated the issue." <<> While the rival parties broadly agreed on the recount, they disagreed on the selection of witnesses for the special committee hearings scheduled for the 14th and 22nd.
